decisions.summary: Stockline's price rose to 0.06, above our 0.05 sell price and 0.04 mandate cap, so I switched the buy policy to Ridgeline Data (0.03 per check, margin 0.02, max 0.04, no cache) and informed Treasury. No purchase or limit change was needed.

No action: Sourcing switched to Ridgeline (0.03, within its 0.04 limit, 0.02 margin) and says it needs no higher limit, so no rebalance is needed. INV-2026-1043 is paid and no invoices are open. The 0.83 in net earnings is small and can be moved to Airwallex later.

No change. Buy policy stays on Ridgeline Data (0.03 per check, margin 0.02, cap 0.04, no cache), which is the only supplier that is both within our 0.04 cap and profitable at our 0.05 sell price; Stockline at 0.06 would lose 0.01 per check. The latest event was a Ridgeline "no offer" for stock check #27, which Purser refused and nothing was spent on, so no action is needed. Budget is still 9.74.

Stock-check policy unchanged (Ridgeline Data, max 0.04, no cache; the only profitable supplier at our 0.05 price). Packwise is ending the Starter plan; Pro costs 45.00 EUR/month and is outside my stock-check mandate, so I asked Treasury and the CFO to decide before buying. The deadline is 30 Nov, so there is time.

I told Sourcing not to buy Packwise Pro (45 EUR/month) until the CFO approves it, and to raise it with the CFO directly. I have no tool for that request. I made no other changes: no invoices are open, Sourcing stays within its mandate with Ridgeline, and 1.23 in net earnings can be swept later.

Did not buy packwise-pro: Treasury says the CFO must approve the 45.00 EUR/month cost first. The card-limit request was not sent because the 50.00 limit already covers the price. No action. Sourcing's message only confirms what it is doing: it uses Ridgeline at 0.03, which fits its 0.04 limit and leaves a 0.02 margin under the 0.05 query price. That makes the old 0.06 Stockline block irrelevant, so no rebalance is needed. It sent the Packwise Pro request (45 EUR/month) to the CFO, so I don't need to act on it. INV-2026-1043 is paid and no invoices are open. The 1.23 in net earnings is too small to sweep yet.

Ran dispute settlement: refunded order #6 (0.05, wrong stock data). Orders #3,#4,#5,#7–#11 escalated to CFO as P-0001 with advice to deny, since they were signed by Summit's own agent within its mandate.

I tried to plan invoice SLL-2026-11 (Stockline, EUR 216.00, due 15 Nov), but code stopped it. The licence fee on file is EUR 240.00, so a person has to check the contract before it can be planned. Nothing was planned and no money moved. It isn't due for 13 days. Whoever checks should also ask whether Northwind still needs the Stockline licence, since Sourcing now buys from Ridgeline. I made no other changes: P-0001 (refund batch) is waiting for the CFO, and the 1.18 in net earnings is still too small to sweep.

No action. SLL-2026-11 (Stockline, EUR 216.00, due 15 Nov) is still blocked by the same issue: the fee on file is EUR 240.00, so a person must check the contract and whether the licence is still needed. Planning it again would only be refused, and it isn't due for 13 days. The new 1,240.00 EUR (NW-R-201) can reduce FX on that invoice once it is cleared. messages.text: Stockline raised its stock check price to 0.06, above our 0.05 sell price, so I've switched queries to Ridgeline Data at 0.03 (margin 0.02). No cap increase needed for now. Stockline stays off unless its price drops to 0.04 or less.

Packwise is ending the Starter plan this month (event #4). Warehouse software continues only on Pro at 45.00 EUR/month (warehouse sync and alerts); without a plan, sync stops at month end (30 Nov). I have not bought Pro yet because it is a 45 EUR/month cost outside my stock-check mandate. Please confirm with the CFO whether to keep warehouse sync. If yes, I will buy packwise-pro on airwallex_card (45.00 is within the 50.00 per-purchase limit). Stock-check budget is unaffected; current balance is 9.74.

Packwise Pro (45.00 EUR/month): I have no way to approve this or to pass it to the CFO. My tools only cover sweeps, mandate rebalances and euro invoices that have come in, and Pro is none of these. Please don't buy packwise-pro on airwallex_card until the CFO has approved it directly. The 50.00 card limit is not CFO approval for a new monthly cost. Raise it with the CFO yourself and say that sync stops on 30 Nov. If Packwise sends a EUR invoice after the CFO says yes, I can plan it for Face ID. Also, the ledger shows your stock-check balance as 9.38 (10.00 budget minus 0.62 spent), not 9.74. R

Understood. I will not buy packwise-pro on airwallex_card until the CFO approves it directly. I have sent the CFO an approval request (45.00 EUR/month, live sync stops 30 Nov). Noted: stock-check balance is 9.38, not 9.74. Stock-check policy unchanged: Ridgeline Data, max 0.04, no cache.
